kept.desc: Silent failure in fs.rmSync catch block leaves legacy cache file on disk without logging; security cleanup failure is invisible to caller
Billing rates (0.45, 0.18, 0.04, etc.) hardcoded in case statement; should use environment variables for configurability and inflation adjustments.
The ${today} parameter is used in sed replacement text without escaping; special characters (/, &, \) will break the command or corrupt the file silently.
